title: Verified download receipts are overwritten at protocol completion or next offer
trigger: Successful download emits FileSaved, then Finished, or a following DownloadOffered; both may be processed in one foreground poll.
impact: The only saved-file path/byte count/SHA256 receipt is replaced by generic completion text or the next offer. A user cannot inspect or retain the verified saved-file receipt after completion; it may never be painted. Batch downloads also lose every preceding saved-file receipt.
evidence: FileSaved stores data only in current.feedback at terminal_zmodem.rs:290-299
Finished calls end_zmodem and overwrites that field at terminal_zmodem.rs:379-381
DownloadOffered replaces the entire current Transfer at terminal_zmodem.rs:188-208
State/Transfer contain no saved receipt collection and render only the current summary/feedback and unresolved results
verification: Source-level data-flow proof; no new test compiled.
